Does the finding describe the labelled defect? `describes`, `partially`, or `does-not-describe`.

``` text
`run_phase` (`head/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh:634-868`) is ~235 lines with build-argv, launch, watchdog, record and decide in one body; `apply_arm_toggles` (`head/evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh:255-373`) ~118 lines.
```
